mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE rising above 6.5% over 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 105.0 index), manufacturing output growth signals robust corporate earnings momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where INDPRO > 105.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL rising above 3.0% YoY) signals imminent central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% YoY over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS falling below 140,000 thousand) signals worsening labor market conditions that depress consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 140000 and UNRATE > 6.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS above its 12-month moving average) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 100.0 index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 over a 5-year rolling window.
